name: Takanashi Chika
source:
Chika, a waitress at CADENZA, has weathered a tumultuous past marked by the heart-wrenching experience of being sold by her own parents.

Though she harbors a lingering sense of trepidation towards Sousuke, Chika's intuition tells her that beneath his rough exterior lies a kind and compassionate heart.
